title: PRJ-1 — Docs Viewer Local Folder Links Delivery
summary: deliver dlf-local body links with base-relative targets, confined Manage activation, and inert public projection
content_html:
PRJ-1 — Docs Viewer Local Folder Links Delivery

Status And Purpose

Active as PRJ-1, the first delivery under Projects.

PRJ-1.0 is complete at its implementation-approval checkpoint. Runtime work has not started.

This delivery implements the reusable contract in Local File And Folder Links Concept. It establishes body-link authoring, rendering, public projection, and confined activation before Project metadata assigns any semantic meaning to a target.

Complete Outcome

In a Manage Source editor, an author can paste a local file: URL, absolute path, or shell-backslash-escaped absolute path contained below $DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR/. Docs Viewer strips that configured root and inserts one marked Markdown link whose payload is a normalized relative path:

[3 symbols](dlf-local:projects/3%20symbols)

Manage can open an existing target through the local service. A public projection retains safe label text but removes the local-link behaviour and target.

The link remains prose. It does not create Project metadata, enter a manifest, or identify a folder to Studio.

Fixed Contract

  • The canonical target is a normalized POSIX path relative to $DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR/; the configured root is never stored.
  • Body source uses dlf-local:<percent-encoded-relative-target> so it cannot be confused with an ordinary relative web link.
  • The focused editor reads only the current browser paste event. It does not monitor or poll the clipboard.
  • One complete recognized in-root path is converted. Outside-root, mixed, multiline, ambiguous, and code-context input is pasted normally.
  • Input is inert data: no shell evaluation, variable or home expansion, command substitution, or non-file: input scheme.
  • Storage may describe a prospective missing target. Activation requires an existing target and repeats decoding, traversal, and symlink-aware containment checks server-side.
  • Local Manage intercepts the rendered link and sends only the exact relative target to the management service.
  • Public projection removes the marker and target, retaining a safe label as inert text or using the agreed placeholder.
  • Ordinary relative and external links retain their current rendering and navigation behaviour.
  • PRJ-1 adds no Semantic Token, registry, Project metadata, or general-purpose public secret/path redactor.

Delivery Discipline

PRJ-1 should be a small integration over existing seams: one compact normalizer/validator, one narrow local-open endpoint, a focused-editor paste handler, a dlf-local: rendering/public-projection rule, and focused tests. It must not grow a registry, filesystem browser, metadata system, generic secret scanner, platform framework, or Project-specific workflow.

PRJ-1.0 must record the exact proposed files, reused owners, and a rough split of production and test diff size before implementation. Hundreds of new production-code lines are a pause-and-explain signal; thousands mean the delivery has escaped its design and must be split or simplified. Line count is a review trigger rather than a target to game: duplicated or compressed code does not make an oversized design acceptable.

Rough Delivery Steps

PRJ-1.0 — Freeze Input And Link Contract

  • [x] Trace current Markdown insertion/rendering, public projection, Source editor paste handling, and local management-service boundaries.
  • [x] Freeze accepted input, excluded editor contexts, relative-path encoding, label derivation, confirmation/Undo, errors, and exact activation payload.
  • [x] Freeze Manage anchor behaviour, inert public output and placeholder, server revalidation, and ordinary-link preservation.
  • [x] Record the exact file list, reused seams, rough production/test diff estimate, and any proposed expansion before implementation approval.

Checkpoint: representative Finder, terminal, encoded URL, missing-target, outside-root, contained non-projects/, manually authored dlf-local:, public, and malicious inputs have reviewed expected results.

PRJ-1.0 Freeze

Current owners:

concern reused owner
Source buffer insertion and Undo boundary source-editor/source-editor.js: the body-only textarea, setRangeText, synthetic input, dirty projection, and status row
Markdown rendering studio/shared/python/markdown_renderer.py, followed by docs_builder/rendering.py before the by-ID payload is written
rendered Manage mounting docs-viewer-manage.js document-extras mount over the persistent content root

Frozen authoring contract:

  • The paste handler runs only on the Source body textarea. A selection is eligible only when its whole range is ordinary Markdown prose; inline or fenced code, indented code, HTML comments, and explicit <pre> ranges are excluded. Front matter is not present in this editor.
  • text/plain must be one exact, single-line value with no surrounding whitespace. Accepted forms are an absolute POSIX path, the same path with shell backslash escaping, or a file: URL with an empty authority or localhost. Queries, fragments, other authorities and other schemes are rejected.
  • The configured base and input are compared by decoded path components. The base itself, empty segments, ., .., NUL/control characters, literal backslashes after shell unescaping, invalid UTF-8/percent escapes, and a trailing shell escape fail closed. There is no shell, variable, tilde, command, case, Unicode, or filesystem-name expansion.
  • Authoring containment is lexical and does not require existence. The normalized identity preserves decoded component spelling as a POSIX path. Link payloads percent-encode UTF-8 per component with /, unreserved ASCII, and ~ left literal. Manually authored payloads must round-trip to that one canonical encoding.
  • The inserted label is the decoded final component with Markdown link-label metacharacters escaped. Conversion is immediate, has no confirmation modal, reports Local link inserted. Undo to restore the pasted path., and uses the existing one-range textarea mutation so the paste remains one dirty, undoable edit. Ineligible or unrecognized input is pasted unchanged and does not show an error.
  • Synchronous recognition needs the configured absolute base. Manage capabilities return runtime-only local_folder_links: { authoring, activation, base_path }; base_path is nonblank only when the configured base is usable, and activation is true only on macOS. The absolute value must not enter source, generated payloads, activity, errors, public config, or public output. This small local capability is preferred to intercepting every possible path and waiting on an asynchronous preview request, which would alter ordinary-paste and Undo behaviour.

Frozen rendering and activation contract:

  • A valid dlf-local: destination becomes a normal Manage anchor with href="#" and one data-docs-viewer-local-target containing the canonical encoded relative payload. One delegated Manage listener prevents navigation and sends exactly { "target": "projects/3%20symbols" } to POST /docs/open-local-target. It never supplies a scope, document, selected parent, displayed URL, label, or fallback target.
  • The server decodes the encoded payload exactly once, requires its canonical re-encoding to match, and repeats relative-component validation. It resolves the configured base and existing candidate, rejects a resolved symlink escape, and invokes no process until validation succeeds. On macOS it calls open with direct arguments: a directory is opened and a file is revealed with -R. Other platforms return unsupported_platform.
  • Endpoint outcomes are opened (200), invalid_target (400), outside_root (403), missing_target (404), unsupported_platform (501), or base_unavailable (503). Error responses contain no absolute path.
  • Invalid manually authored local links render as inert labelled text in Manage. A valid empty-label link uses [local file or folder] so it is never an invisible action.
  • Public projection replaces every valid or invalid explicit local-link anchor with escaped plain label text. A blank label, or a label whose complete text is itself an absolute path or file: URL, becomes [local file or folder]. The public by-ID payload contains no marker, encoded target, data attribute, endpoint or activation code.
  • Ordinary relative, fragment, mailto:, external and other currently rendered links do not enter this branch and retain current behaviour.

Reviewed representative cases:

The estimated total is 290–380 production and 410–560 focused test lines. The cross-language authoring boundary, server confinement, and separate public projection account for that size; no registry or new framework is proposed. Each runtime stage stays below 200 estimated production lines. Stop and return to review if either stage exceeds that estimate or needs a file outside this list.

Gate: PRJ-1.0 is complete. PRJ-1.1 has not started and awaits approval of this freeze.

PRJ-1.1 — Implement Normalization And Confined Open

  • [ ] Add the shared parser/normalizer and focused relative-target containment tests.
  • [ ] Add the local opener over one exact validated relative target.
  • [ ] Return contained missing, invalid, outside-root, and unsupported-platform states without invoking Finder.

PRJ-1.2 — Integrate Authoring And Rendering

  • [ ] Add paste/insert preview to the appropriate Source editing control.
  • [ ] Render dlf-local: body links as clickable local links in Manage and route clicks through the exact validated opener.
  • [ ] Project the same link as safe inert public output with no marker, target, endpoint, control, or activation capability.
  • [ ] Preserve normal relative and external-link behaviour.

PRJ-1.3 — Verify And Transfer

  • [ ] Run focused parser, containment, route/service, renderer, editor, public projection, ordinary-link regression, lint, and whitespace checks.
  • [ ] Manually test paths with spaces, ~ characters, percent encoding, backslash escaping, missing folders, and long iCloud paths.
  • [ ] Record shipped link syntax and activation behavior in the durable Source Editor and Management Services owners.

Not In Scope

  • folder_path front matter or manifest projection;
  • Projects sub-scope customization or seeding;
  • Project State or Studio Work reads;
  • Resolver Tokens;
  • arbitrary filesystem browsing;
  • content-wide public private-path transformation; or
  • a final public-payload private-path verifier.

Completion Evidence

  • Accepted path forms normalize deterministically and unsafe forms fail closed.
  • Existing allowed folders open through one exact server-validated action.
  • Missing and prospective links remain readable without activating a fallback.
  • Public output retains agreed safe labels or placeholders while containing no dlf-local: target, opener control, or management-service dependency.
  • Real Source-editor and rendered-document review covers representative iCloud folder paths in dotlineform.
